components.name: Microsoft WebView2 SDK static loader

components.verification: The crate's x64/WebView2LoaderStatic.lib is byte-identical to build/native/x64/WebView2LoaderStatic.lib in the pinned NuGet package. SHA-256: 0659b741bde6348d4c4a6ec4ceb9af50e3d0048ed9cd3c8659bccbb61fde55ee. The complete package NOTICE is retained conservatively, including build-tool notices.
issues: The downloaded Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is a separate product governed by its own terms; this SDK loader license does not cover that runtime. The installer currently fetches an unpinned Evergreen bootstrapper from Microsoft.

components.name: nsis-tauri-utils and nsis-plugin-api

issues: Upstream tag declares normal dependencies on semver 1.0 and windows-sys 0.61.2, plus its own nsis-plugin-api; no Cargo.lock is published at that tag. Their license texts are present in the application inventory, but exact versions embedded in the prebuilt helper DLL require a vendor build manifest. nsis-fn is a proc macro and is not shipped.

components.name: Rust and platform compiler runtime code
components.distribution: Rust standard/compiler runtime code may be linked; build.rs explicitly links Apple's libclang_rt.osx.a on macOS. Windows links the system CRT according to the release toolchain defaults.
issues: Pin the release Rust, MSVC and Xcode toolchains and archive their exact runtime notices. No built Windows installer or macOS binary was inspected in this source-only task, and the exact macOS compiler runtime revision is not available in this Windows checkout. OS-provided frameworks and system CRTs are not redistributed as separate app resources.

components.name: ring vendored BoringSSL and fiat-crypto code

components.name: RNNoise code and embedded neural-network weights in nnnoiseless
components.distribution: Rust port and embedded default weights used for recognition gating

issues: Upstream uses REUSE-style SPDX copyright headers. The pinned upstream MIT terms contain placeholders; source copyright headers are retained separately without rewriting.
The source headers declare MPL-2.0 and link the standard terms; the crate does not include a standalone full license file. Exact standard terms and source attribution are supplied separately.
The wrapper declares Unlicense but ships no standalone wrapper license file. Standard Unlicense terms are provided separately; whisper.cpp and ggml retain their MIT terms.
